title: LuLu: Un Conte Interactif de Romain Victor-Pujebet
overview:
Meet the memories of the future.

Click on words and pictures, and beautiful illustrations like 19th-century paintings begin to move just like a film.

Lulu is an interactive picture book by Romain Victor-Pujebet, made to be read, listened to and clicked. A little robot named Nemo tumbles into Lulu's book, and their meeting leads to a fantastic journey from the jungle to the polar ice, full of discoveries.

Turn the pages, follow the narrated story, and click on the text and the ink-and-paper illustrations to bring each scene to life. The Japanese version features full narration and character voices.

- A "click book" for one player
- Mouse compatible

未来の記憶に会う。

文字や絵をクリックすると、19世紀の絵画のような美しい挿し絵がまるで映画のように動きだす。
